description: GAP-01 used: the 13 annexes were treated as units of W and coded like operative provisions: Annexes I, II, III and X as scope statements and external references (Annex I and X entries one external reference per act), Annexes IV, V, VIII, IX, XI, XII as content statements (with assignments for Annexes VI, VIII and IX), Annex VII as relations between provider and notified body, Annex XIII as an assignment of the Commission
reason: Execution addendum GAP-01: annexes belong to W and are subject to the same admission and traceability rules; content must satisfy the admission rule
impact: Annex content produced statements, 4 derived assignments (Annexes VIII and IX), 1 direct assignment (Annex VI), 1 direct assignment (Annex XIII) and the Annex VII relations; headings of annexes and sections are inventoried as HEADING_ONLY units and not evidence

description: GAP-02 used: Articles 102 to 110 (amendments of other acts) were recorded as statements and external references with reference_role other; one assignment (Article 105, Commission named in the inserted paragraph) was coded for the effect expressed in W; the amended acts were not added to W or retrieved
impact: 9 external references of the amendment type; no relation of W coded from the amended acts; where the adopter of acts is determined by the amended act no assignment was coded

description: GAP-03 used: internal cross-references were followed inside W to resolve obligors, counterparts, conditions and definitions; 31 assignments and 64 relations are marked derived with the derivation rule and the supporting units (for example the identification of the law enforcement authority in Article 5(3)-(4) through Article 5(2) and Article 3(46), instructions for use in Article 13 through Article 3(15), the AI Office coded to the Commission through Article 3(47))
reason: Execution addendum GAP-03: cross-references inside W may be followed and remain inside W; the inferential path must not be hidden
impact: Derived records are provisional and the cross-reference readings are queued where ambiguous (HQ-XREF)

description: GAP-04 used: no external legal retrieval was performed; 59 external references were recorded with source_verification_status not_checked and boundary_status outside_corpus_not_expanded; 39 of them carry a constitutive dependency, and the dependent claims were kept at documented level with the dependency stated or recorded as undetermined
reason: Execution addendum GAP-04: external retrieval prohibited during case execution
impact: Claims about the content of external instruments (market surveillance powers under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, harmonised standards, sectoral acts of Annex I, the committee procedure of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011, data protection law) are undetermined or restricted to the declared corpus

description: GAP-05 used: the function vocabulary of the data dictionary was used without additions; FUNCTION_VOCABULARY_UNRESOLVED was written in the function field of 27 assignments (mainly prohibitions, savings clauses and constraints without a documented governance function) and the flagged residual tags were used where they fit (24 assignments and 79 relations), with the asterisk of the dictionary retained as the flag
reason: Execution addendum GAP-05: do not force classification; use the protocol flagged residual tag only if it fits
impact: Function-based statements are limited for prohibitions; no new category was created

description: GAP-06 used: NON_OPERATIVE_SOURCE_GAP recorded: the six questions of the operational template were not reconstructed and no admission, exclusion or inference rule was taken from them; the four-step anti-circularity sequence and I1-I4 were used
reason: Execution addendum GAP-06 (the six questions are absent from the authorized sources)

description: GAP-07 used: definition provisions of Article 3 were screened as scope/definitional-context; statements and positions or devices were derived only for definitions that identify a position or device or support an operative record (provider, deployer, authorised representative, importer, distributor, operator, notifying authority, conformity assessment body, notified body, market surveillance authority, national competent authority, law enforcement authority, AI Office, sandbox, test subject, downstream provider); no relation, authority or accountability was derived from a definition alone
impact: Definitions without governance content (for example technical and data terms) are screened No and remain available as support units

description: Unit identifier forms beyond the printed rule were adopted: SP{n} for unnumbered subparagraphs, pt{label} for labelled points and sub-points (nested), P0 for unnumbered article bodies, S{label}.P0 and S{label}.HEAD for annex sections, CIT{n}, PRE.P1, PRE.ENACT, TITLE and FIN.* for formal units and CH{roman}.SEC{n} for chapter and section headings (HEADING_ONLY)
reason: RGAM-DR-05 does not cover these structural cases
impact: Identifiers are stable and unique; footnote apparatus (58 notes giving Official Journal citations) is declared as an exclusion in W_DECLARATION and not inventoried

description: Two devices, the EU database and the AI regulatory sandbox, are used as counterparts of relations (registration, access, control, establishment) because the text names them as the object of registration, access or control; the dictionary lists position, defined category or institutional forum as parties
reason: RGAM-DR-14 does not address devices as parties
impact: Relations with a device counterpart are flagged (HQ-GAP) and the operator of the device is coded in separate relations

description: property_family (F1-F5) is left blank for all properties because the mapping of the ten dimensions to families is stated in the ontology section 6.1, which is not an allow-listed source
reason: Information UNAVAILABLE in the allow-listed sources; not invented
impact: No family-level reading of the property register

description: Recitals REC34 to REC180 were screened from their opening text (first 400 to 520 characters) and length; REC1 to REC33 and all operative articles, annexes and formal provisions were read in full
reason: Recitals create no assignment, position, device, relation or external reference under RGAM-DR-07, so their screening result is determinate; reading effort was concentrated on operative text
impact: All 180 recitals are screened No (interpretive context only); a late-text detail of a recital could not have created a record

description: accountability_class was recorded independently of relation_type: ANSWERABILITY was attached to relations of types information_reporting, review_adjudication and accountability, ACCOUNTABILITY (derived, sufficiency indeterminate) to two relations of type accountability; accountable_via pointers from other relations point to those two
reason: The dictionary does not map classes to relation types
